title.narrative: Preventing Human Trafficking and Smuggling of Human Beings in Nigeria

description.narrative: 1. Increasing public awareness and access to rescue support – sensitizing 40,000 vulnerable individuals, training 180 community members put information about assistance in the hands of 700 returned victims and survivors of trafficking. 2. Economic impact through training and business opportunities – targeting 600 returnees/survivors to increase their hire ability and life skills and 100 returnees/survivors for educational advancement. 3. Changing the landscape of knowledge-sharing through High Level Advocacy Engagement and Capacity Building – knowledge-sharing with 50 industry experts across counter human trafficking organizations, government, and law enforcement and capacity building of MeCAHT staff.

title.narrative: Output 1.3: Social Media and Radio

Weekly social media and monthly radio programming for outreach to 100 smuggled migrants and active victims of trafficking. title.narrative: Output 1.1: Awareness and Campaign

1. Impacting the perspective and behaviour of 40,000 people from 50 communities in 6 States toward human trafficking, its victims, risks and precautions. 2. 40,000 people from 50 communities in 6 states are sensitized about the risks and signs of human trafficking, by watching the film and completing pre- and post- film and training questionnaires as well as Q&A surveys to determine effectiveness and impact on perspective and future behaviour 3. Prevention by identifying trafficking and smuggling cases and reporting of suspicious activities or decrease in trafficking incidents in the 6 states.

target.value: Conduct awareness campaigns and educational initiatives to sensitize 10,000 people from 50 communities in 6 states about the risks and signs of human trafficking, using pre- and post- training questionnaires as well as Q&A surveys to determine effectiveness and impact on perspective and future behaviour.

actual.value: A groundbreaking awareness campaign reached 14,128 individuals through the impactful I Wish I Knew movie, highlighting survivors stories, traffickers tactics, and ways to identify and report trafficking cases. Pre and post questionnaires evaluated the campaigns effectiveness, revealing significant improvements in participants understanding and informing future initiatives. The project has also reached 176 people directly through stakeholders engagement and movie premiere. 32 episodes of the I Wish I Knew radio program have been aired on Eagles FM which has a listenership of over 400,000 per hour.

target.value: Conduct awareness campaigns and educational initiatives to sensitize an additional 10,000 (for composite total of 20,000) people from 50 communities in 6 states about the risks and signs of human trafficking, using pre- and post- training questionnaires as well as Q&A surveys to determine effectiveness and impact on perspective and future behaviour.

title.narrative: Output 3.1: High Level Advocacy Engagement and Capacity Building

1. Increase in the understanding of human trafficking and smuggling between 50 Nigerian and Danish stakeholders documented by MeCAHT and EXIST. 2. 20 MeCAHT staff have improved operational efficiency in financial competence, project design & management, proposal writing, effective reporting, leadership and responsibility. Consequently, staff are able to maintain the expected standards required for managing larger grants and to communicate more effectively between team members, partners, networks, donors, communities and other stakeholders.

target.value: Host 1 high level advocacy event for 25 stakeholders like the Danish Centre against Human Trafficking, Danish Police, Nigerian diaspora community, Nigerian victims and survivors of Human Trafficking and Smuggling and 6 MeCAHT staff in Denmark to increase awareness on human Trafficking issues. Hold a capacity building training in Nigeria for 20 MeCAHT staff in Financial Management and Administration. Mentoring, training assessment and strategic planning for new learnings by EXIST

Host 1 high level advocacy event for 25 stakeholders like the Danish Centre against Human Trafficking, Danish Police, Nigerian diaspora community, Nigerian victims and survivors of human trafficking and smuggling and 6 MeCAHT staff in Denmark to advocate for better coordination of support for victims and survivors of human trafficking and smuggling. Hold a capacity building training for 20 MeCAHT staff Proposal and Report Writing in Nigeria. Mentoring, training assessment and strategic planning for new learnings by EXIST

Host an International Conference for prevention of Human Trafficking in Nigeria, information and experience sharing and to advocate for better coordination of support for victims and survivors of human trafficking and smuggling Hold a capacity building training in Nigeria for 20 MeCAHT staff in Proposal and Report Writing. Mentoring, training assessment and strategic planning for new learnings by EXIST
Host advocacy meeting in Nigeria to review efforts between African Networks in Denmark and Nigeria. Hold a capacity building training in Nigeria for 20 MeCAHT staff in Project Design & Management

Evaluate outcomes of the advocacy engagements by documenting good practices through knowledge sharing and publishing them for industry workers in organizations, legislation and law enforcement. Hold a capacity building training in Nigeria for 20 MeCAHT staff in Leadership and Organizational Development. Mentoring, training assessment and strategic planning for new learnings by EXIST.

title.narrative: Outcome 3: Increased understanding of distinct concerns of human trafficking between Nigeria (source country) and Denmark (Destination country) for increased collaboration and partnership for prevention of more incidences of human trafficking and smuggling between the two countries and the capacity building of MeCAHT staff.

1. Improved collaboration between MeCAHT and EXIST for advocacy collaboration among 25 stakeholders. 2. Enhanced coordination between MeCAHT and EXIST for advocacy collaboration among 25 stakeholders. 3. Strengthened promotion and protection of human rights, advocacy for dignity, equality, justice and support for the Nigerian Victims and Survivors of Human Trafficking and Smuggling in Denmark and Nigeria by December 2028. 4. Improved operational efficiency through capacity building of 20 MeCAHT Program Staff (14 staff and 6 state coordinators).
Outcome 2: Improved economic situation of 700 Survivors/Returnees through creation of alternative livelihood opportunities and education.
